subject: Final redlines and senior clearance request — Halcyon Health deal
messages:
From: Sophia Tran <sophia.tran@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Halcyon Legal <contracts@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final redlines (attached) — ready to close after commercial sync

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week — the pilot went well and the execs at Halcyon are aligned on moving to a production contract. Our GC pushed back on a few terms and attached a redline (Halcyon_Redline_v3.docx). Key asks from their side:

- Liability cap at USD 10M (they proposed removing caps entirely)
- Broader indemnity for product claims tied to patient outcomes
- Warranty language extended from 30 to 90 days with performance SLA remedies
- A 25% up-front discount tied to a multi-year commitment

We can be flexible on price, but legal insists on the above language for enterprise procurement. Can you confirm whether Redwood can sign-off or whether this needs senior clearance? We want to keep the momentum and move to DocuSign this week.

Attachments: Halcyon_Redline_v3.docx

Best,
Sophia
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Halcyon Health

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Tran <sophia.tran@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2029 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final redlines (attached) — ready to close after commercial sync

Sophia — thanks for the redline and for outlining the asks. Looping in Marissa (deal desk) and Laura (legal) to review the risk. Quick notes up front:

- Price: we can move on a commercial concession if they commit to a 24-month term and higher committed TUs.
- Liability/Indemnity: Laura, can you confirm whether the proposed indemnity expansion is a show-stopper?
- Warranty/SLA: We typically keep warranty limited and channel customer remedies into service credits; 90 days + SLA remedies is unusual for this product.

Marissa — any precedent for a 25% onboarding discount for a tiered ARR commitment?

If we need exec sign-off, we should document an offset (higher TCV / revenue protection) and ask for a one-time senior clearance. Sophia, can you confirm the target signature date?

Thanks —
Logan
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2029 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Halcyon redlines — deal desk analysis + ask for senior approval

Forwarding Halcyon redlines with a short deal desk assessment (see attached Commercial_Summary_Q3.pdf). TL;DR:

- Proposed 25% discount increases revenue risk materially for Year 1; at our margins the concession needs a guaranteed minimum TCV of $1.2M to be acceptable.
- Liability cap increase to unlimited (customer redline) is non-starter. Customer asked to raise to USD 10M — that is within a tolerable band if we secure the following offsets: 1) 24-month committed term, 2) joint-limit on consequential damages, 3) indemnity carve-outs for third-party PHI breaches (we keep responsibility limited).
- Warranty extension to 90 days + SLA remedies: recommend granting 60 days with a credit-based remedy capped at monthly recurring revenue for impacted period.

Recommended exec ask: 
- Senior clearance to accept liability cap at USD 10M (instead of standard 1x TCV cap) conditioned on: 24-month MRC commit, no broad consequential indemnity, and a 10% price recovery via amended payment schedule (partial upfront payment).
- Approve a marketing/commercial concession of up to 20% discount (not 25%) if the customer signs the 24-month TCV and agrees to the above risk controls.

Attachments: Commercial_Summary_Q3.pdf

Please confirm whether Aditya can approve under these offsets — if not, we'll escalate to the exec legal signoff route.

—Marissa
Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Mar 2029 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Halcyon redlines — legal position and required controls

Aditya / team — I reviewed Halcyon's redline and their counsel's notes. Summary of material legal risk and proposed contract language:

1) Liability cap: Customer removed the cap entirely. We should not accept unlimited liability. Accepting a USD 10M cap is reasonable for a strategic health-care customer if we get the offsets Marissa listed. Proposed clause: "Aggregate liability of Redwood arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) USD 10,000,000 or (b) total fees paid to Redwood under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim."

2) Indemnity: Customer requests broad indemnity for any third-party claims tied to patient outcomes. We must keep indemnity limited to: (a) claims alleging IP infringement by Redwood, (b) claims arising from Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and (c) third-party claims resulting from a breach of Redwood's obligations to secure PHI where Redwood is proven at fault. Add an express carve-out excluding consequential damages and avoid open-ended clinical outcome indemnities.

3) Warranty / SLA: Recommend 60-day warranty with remedies limited to service credits, and an SLA credit ladder tied to availability (0.1% credit per hour beyond SLA up to a dollar cap equal to one month's MRC). Avoid duty to cure clinical outcomes.

4) Audit & Data Controls: Given the regulated nature, require annual security attestation (SOC2 type II) and customer-specific security questionnaire to be attached as an exhibit — we should not expose raw logs beyond a mutual NDAs scope.

Legal asks for explicit senior clearance because: the 10M cap deviates from standard 1x TCV cap and the indemnity carve language is more customer-favorable. If leadership approves the offsets outlined below, legal will finalize language and issue a DocuSign-ready package.

Required commercial offsets for sign-off: 24-month committed TCV >= USD 1.2M, 20% maximum discount, 30% upfront payment on execution.

If approved, I'll prepare the final contract with the proposed language and redline back to Halcyon for signoff.

—Laura Bennett
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2029 18:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Halcyon redlines — senior clearance decision

Team — I reviewed the deal desk analysis and Laura's legal summary. This is a strategic target in a prioritized vertical; I'm comfortable granting a one-time senior clearance under the following firm conditions: 

- Liability cap set to USD 10,000,000 (no unlimited exposure) with the hybrid floor: greater of USD 10M or fees paid in prior 12 months.
- Indemnity limited to IP, Redwood gross negligence/willful misconduct, and proven Redwood-caused PHI breaches; exclude clinical outcome indemnity.
- Warranty limited to 60 days with service-credit remedies capped at one month's MRC; no cure obligation for clinical outcomes.
- Commercial offsets are required: 24-month committed TCV >= USD 1.25M, 20% max discount, and 30% upfront payment; include an indexed price clause for years 2+.

Logan — proceed to document this in the contract. Laura, please prepare DocuSign package with the clauses above and mark as "Senior Clearance — Aditya 2029-04-01". Marissa, update the HubSpot deal with the clearance and the revenue recognition notes.

Approving on the condition we do not repeat this exception without a quarterly review of similar cases.

—Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
